name: Nanded–Chitradurga Highway
aka: Vijayapura–Chitradurga section was part of the former NH 13 (old numbering)
history: NH 50 crosses the Deccan plateau from Nanded in Maharashtra to Chitradurga in Karnataka. Along the way it strings together the old fort cities of Bidar, Kalaburagi and Vijayapura, then runs south past Hosapete, the gateway to the ruins of Hampi. It ends at Chitradurga, where it meets the Pune–Bengaluru highway, NH 48. Most of the southern half was the old NH 13, a long-established route through northern Karnataka, and the rest was joined on in the 2010 renumbering. The road follows a line of history: Bidar and Kalaburagi were capitals of the Bahmani sultanate, Vijayapura (Bijapur) of the Adil Shahis, and Hampi of the Vijayanagara empire, so a drive down NH 50 passes forts, tombs and temple ruins from four different kingdoms.
facts: About 641 of its 751 km lie in Karnataka.
Passes Hosapete, the gateway to Hampi, a World Heritage Site.
The Vijayapura–Chitradurga stretch was part of the old NH 13.
Links three historic Deccan cities in a row: Bidar, Kalaburagi and Vijayapura.
Ilkal, on the route, is famous across India for its handwoven Ilkal sarees.
It meets NH 63 at Udgir, NH 65 at Humnabad, NH 52 at Vijayapura and NH 48 at Chitradurga.
The road runs through the granite country of Hunagund, Ilkal and Kushtagi, one of Karnataka's biggest stone-quarrying belts.
significance: NH 50 is the main road of the Kalyana-Karnataka region — the northern districts that historically had the fewest highways. It gives Bidar, Kalaburagi, Vijayapura and Hosapete a direct link both north into Marathwada and south to the Bengaluru corridor at Chitradurga, and it carries the region's cement, granite, sugar and pulses out to market. It is also the tourist road to Hampi, Bidar Fort, the Gol Gumbaz at Vijayapura and the temples of Aihole and Pattadakal.

travelNotes: This is dry, open Deccan country — long straight stretches, few hills and very hot weather from March to May, so November to February is by far the best time to drive it. Nanded to Chitradurga is a long two-day trip; Kalaburagi and Vijayapura are the natural overnight stops and both have plenty of hotels. Watch for slow-moving granite and cement trucks around Ilkal and Kushtagi, and for bullock carts and sugarcane tractors near the smaller towns. Hosapete is the place to break the journey if you want to see Hampi.
